profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer at Walmart
profile.summary: Backend software engineer with experience designing and deploying scalable APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS in production environments. Skilled in building cloud infrastructure, optimizing data pipelines, and writing automated tests to keep systems reliable as they grow. Passionate about clean, well-architected backends that perform at scale.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: Involves ensuring gaming systems meet strict regulatory compliance standards through a combination of custom tooling, automated workflows, and hands-on code analysis. C#/.NET Windows applications were engineered to streamline testing and file management processes for staff, while Bash and Python scripts automated compilation, signing, and logging to maintain consistent imaging across devices. Regression testing and thorough code analysis helped catch critical bugs that could otherwise violate regulatory clauses, contributing directly to the integrity of certified gaming systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Hardware Testing · Test Planning · Quality Assurance · C++

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Designed and deployed REST and SOAP APIs using Node.js and TypeScript to manage customer data and insurance policies at scale. Cloud infrastructure was built and maintained through AWS CloudFormation and API Gateway, with JWT-based authentication secured via AWS Secrets Manager. Beyond API development, significant effort went into optimizing Snowflake stored procedures and StreamSets data ingestion pipelines, ultimately reducing compute costs by 40%. Production reliability was ensured through monitoring and alerting with AWS CloudWatch and Splunk, while automated unit and integration testing with Jest and Postman ran through CodeBuild pipelines. Release coordination involved CodePipeline stage-gate approvals alongside on-call incident response responsibilities.
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · JavaScript · Node.js

company.name: CSAA Insurance Group, a AAA Insurer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · On-site
positions.description: Focused on developing C++ game engines and custom in-house SDKs powering electronic gaming machines in a highly regulated industry. A core part of the work involved profiling and refactoring client-server communications using C++ and gRPC to identify and eliminate memory leaks that impacted performance. Regulated gaming features were engineered for the in-house Game Development Kit, ensuring strict compliance with replay and random number generation standards. Custom integration and unit testing scripts were also designed to improve overall code reliability across the engine.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Game Development · gRPC · API Development

positions.title: Technical Engineer Intern
positions.description: Centered on firmware validation and embedded systems automation within Intel's hardware engineering workflow. The primary firmware validation pipeline was developed in Python, replacing previously manual intervention steps with a fully automated process. Custom tooling was built across Python, Linux Bash, and Windows CMD to automate embedded firmware updates, with retry logic engineered for device-specific commands to reduce flash failures and enable unattended operation. Hardware reporting was also streamlined by creating scripts with Python, pandas, and openpyxl to generate structured .xlsx reports for engineering teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · Python · Test Automation · Software Documentation
